treatment_plan.definitive: Full-mouth tooth extraction correction, aligning and leveling the entire dentition, closing scattered gaps in the entire dentition, adjusting the overbite coverage of the front teeth, finely adjusting the occlusion of the entire dentition, and improving facial appearance.
treatment_plan.notes: Avoid biting hard objects. If pulp symptoms occur, perform root canal treatment and follow up for follow-up consultation if any discomfort occurs.
